findings.title: Wallet auth signature covers only a timestamp, so it is replayable and not bound to the request
Replay check is not atomic (check-then-add around an await), and the store is in-memory only
Paid routes never dedupe txHash; one fabricated proof can mint unlimited cards or funding
Settle response body (settled flag) never checked; settled:false treated as success
STELLAR_NETWORK and numeric settings are unvalidated free-form values
Unwired card repository: unvalidated float balance and 32-bit card IDs
Webhook HMAC compare throws on length mismatch, giving a 500 instead of 401
Webhook replay protection is in-memory only, with no timestamp freshness check and a random fallback key

failing_checks.title: Asset identity and units
failing_checks.reason: The check compares a string the payer supplies. It never checks the asset or issuer in the proof, and nothing on the ledger confirms the amount.

failing_checks.title: Replay and double payment
failing_checks.reason: The middleware never calls the paymentService replay store, so the same txHash can be reused indefinitely. The store is also in memory and is only marked after verification.

failing_checks.title: Incoming payment verification
failing_checks.reason: The payment is not verified on-chain or through the facilitator. paymentService.verifyAndAccept has no caller.

failing_checks.title: Failure and rollback paths
failing_checks.reason: Settlement failure is only logged (TODO to mark settle_failed); the txHash is already marked used and the service already delivered, so a failed settlement leaves a paid-looking order with no reconciliation. failing_checks.title: Caller authentication
failing_checks.reason: Paid routes that create and fund cards rely on an unverified X-Payment header; PaymentService.verifyAndAccept has no caller.

failing_checks.title: Tenant isolation
failing_checks.reason: The payer wallet comes from the unauthenticated proof. A caller can create or fund cards under another wallet's address. Card reads and freezes are bound to the authenticated wallet, but the wallet signature covers only a timestamp and can be replayed.

failing_checks.title: Approvals fail closed
failing_checks.reason: The payment gate approves from a requester-supplied header with no verification step, so it is not a fail-closed approval.

failing_checks.title: Verification of incoming authentication
failing_checks.reason: The payment proof carries no verified signature. The wallet auth signature is replayable. The webhook HMAC compare throws on a length mismatch.

failing_checks.title: Controls outside the prompt
failing_checks.reason: The payment gate checks only the fields in the client-supplied proof. It never verifies the txHash. PaymentService.verifyAndAccept has no caller, so the facilitator is never invoked.

failing_checks.title: Stated purpose versus behaviour
failing_checks.reason: The service presents itself as a paid card-issuing service with facilitator verification and settlement. The shipped path verifies nothing, and cards are mock objects.

failing_checks.title: Core function works
failing_checks.reason: The core paid path does not work as intended: the facilitator verify and settle code is dead, and state is kept only in memory.
